about: Configuration of the method (method/README.md). Changing it is a method change: commits need a Method trailer.

text_only.about: Translation text needs no Serves trailer: the gate judges changes to behaviour, and text does not change it. Exempt: another repository's files below these folders; a patch in notes_root whose every file lies below them; the notes (.md anywhere below notes_root, .json in its subfolders). Everything else stays gated.
